text: I track my spending every Sunday evening.
Our household budget is on a spreadsheet and I update it monthly.
I think I am saving enough, but then a bill arrives and I doubt it.
I am proud of finishing the emergency fund, yet scared to touch any of it.
I want to keep my money completely safe and also double it in two years.
Avoid risk, but I do not mind losing some if the upside is big.
Not sure how I feel about all of this.
Money.
Fine, I guess.
Oh wonderful, the rent went up again.
Mujhe apne paise surakshit rakhne hain lekin thoda growth bhi chahiye.
Loan ki EMI ki wajah se thoda tension hai.
Savings badhane ka plan hai, bahut excited hoon.
Quiero ahorrar mas, pero me preocupa el futuro.
Ich moechte Schulden abbauen.
I am relieved the loan is almost paid off.
I do not feel anxious about the market at all.
Could be worried, could be fine, hard to say.
I would never lock money away where I cannot reach it.
Maybe a bit more growth would be nice someday.
I am angry that prices keep rising while my pay does not.
Hopeful about the year ahead, though the electricity bill worries me.
I have a plan for my child's school fees and it feels manageable.
Please just tell me what to buy.
My friend says invest in everything, I am not so sure.
The sunrise was lovely this morning.
I lost sleep over my credit card statement.
I need cash available quickly, and I also want my savings to grow steadily.
It is what it is.
